international.summary: Follow live updates today and results tonight as Labor’s Ben Carroll and Liberal leader Jess Wilson seek victory in Victoria’s state election Victorian election 2026 guide: what you need to know Confused about who to vote for? Check the parties’ key promises and policies See all of our Victorian state election coverage Get our daily political email , free app or daily news podcast Bowen says election has been ‘a tough one for Labor’ The federal climate minister, Chris Bowen , was asked at a doorstop in Fairfield, NSW, this morning on what he’s expecting from the Victorian state election. I give a shoutout to all those Labor party workers who are handing out how-to-votes, the candidates who are working their guts out, but they know that it’s going to be very, very tough. And we know that this election campaign has been dominated by really the sorts of issues that you get when a government’s been in for more than 10 years. Surprisingly, I think it’s a consequence of knowing that we’ve put our best foot forward. We’ve left nothing on the table. There’s nothing left in the tank. So, you know, now it’s up to the people of Victoria. We are definitely not taking anything for granted. Things feel good. People are absolutely ready for change. As to whether they want to vote to achieve it by voting differently remains to be seen, but we’re hopeful. Continue reading...
